What this experience covers

An Old Town night typically runs evening pickup at a hotel, house, or Airbnb, then a first confirmed Old Town venue, additional confirmed stops on a compact route, optional late-night food if timing allows, and a scheduled return to one address. Bookings are hourly charters: stops sit inside the window you buy. Party units are priced by the hour on a published minimum — see the nightlife service page and live checkout for current figures. Share every venue address and the return time when you request service so curb access and the communication plan can be confirmed in writing.

Example itinerary

  1. Evening pickup at the confirmed address. Name a trip lead who holds the phone and knows the approved curb.
  2. First confirmed Old Town venue. Drop at the venue's current access point — access changes with closures and traffic controls.
  3. Additional confirmed venues within a compact route. Keep the stop list practical; last-minute extra addresses may not fit remaining hours.
  4. Late-night food if timing allows. Add the food address when you book.
  5. Scheduled return to the confirmed address. One return plan for the whole group.

Waiting, curb access, and bar hours

Curb access in Old Town depends on closures, valet rules, traffic controls, and each venue's policies. Waiting and staging depend on the requested service window and those venue rules — the written confirmation identifies the communication plan and approved pickup points. Commercial vehicles follow posted rules and officer direction; Scottsdale Sprinters will not invent a guaranteed unmarked curb. Hours, admission, and alcohol service are controlled by each venue and current Arizona law — check venues directly, then submit confirmed reservations and your return time with the transportation request.

House rules (alcohol and decor)

Follow published house rules and Arizona vehicle-for-hire open-container rules. Passengers 21+ may bring their own alcohol only when allowed for that vehicle and stated in booking terms; Scottsdale Sprinters does not sell alcohol. If anyone under 21 rides, alcohol does not come on board that trip. Read /ride-rules and ask reservations before you plan an onboard toast. Decor and props: confirm what is allowed for the assigned vehicle before the night — do not assume party-store decorations are cleared.

Split drops and under-21 riders

Split drop-offs to different hotels can be requested when every address is on the reservation and the remaining hours cover the route. Last-minute extra addresses may not fit. If anyone under 21 rides, alcohol does not come on board that trip. Confirm the house-rules sentence against /ride-rules and the nightlife service page before you plan an onboard toast.
